items.title: 김민석, ‘0.87%p’ 차이로 누적 1위 탈환…제주·인천서 정청래 제쳐 - 한겨레

summaries.ko: 더불어민주당 당대표 선거에서 김민석 후보가 제주·인천 순회경선 결과에 힘입어 정청래 후보를 0.87%p 차이로 제치고 누적 1위를 탈환했다.
summaries.en: In the Democratic Party's leader election, Kim Min-seok reclaimed the cumulative first place, overtaking Jung Chung-rae by a narrow 0.87 percentage point margin following the results of the Jeju and Incheon regional primaries.
summaries.zh: 在共同民主党党首选举中，金民锡候选人凭借济州和仁川地区巡回竞选结果，以0.87个百分点的微弱优势超越郑清来候选人，重新夺回累计第一的宝座。

summaries.en: On July 7th, two heat-related deaths, one each in Seoul's Gangnam-gu and Jungnang-gu, occurred, marking the highest daily count this year.
